title: Social Media Is Sharing Words For Rasheeda After She Dropped A Few Bars About Never Leaving Kirk Frost (WATCH) - NewsBreak
text: Social media is sharing words for Rasheeda after she dropped a few bars about never leaving her husband, Kirk Frost , in a ‘Love and Hip Hop: Atlanta’ clip. On Tuesday, July 8, The Shade Room reposted a clip from ‘Love & Hip Hop Atlanta’ that showcased Rasheeda dropping a few bars. To note, the clip appears to be from the show’s season 13 return on July 8. Furthermore, in the clip, Rasheeda is seen standing in front of her Pressed boutique while rapping in front of a mic. “Yo, this a light day — it’s light work,” she raps. “And y’all can pop y’all s**t, ’cause I ain’t leaving Kirk.” Check out her freestyle clip below. Social media users immediately reacted to Rasheeda’s bars in the ‘Love & Hip Hop Atlanta’ clip in The Shade Room’s comment section . While Instagram user @bq.garrett added, “ Please keep him. We love when yall keep the dirt of the streets sis” Before dropping her quick bars about Kirk Frost, Rasheeda was turnin’ heads online with a fresh look. As The Shade Room previously reported, in June, the rapper debuted a protective style with jumbo twists and gray boho waves. Ultimately, the style left social media users sharing mixed reactions. The post appeared first on .
